package middleware

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
)

// AuthMiddleware extracts user data from X-User-ID/X-User-Role headers.
type AuthMiddleware struct{}

func (m AuthMiddleware) Middleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		userID := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("X-User-ID"))
		role := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("X-User-Role")))
		if userID == "" || role == "" {
			log.Printf("unauthorized: missing auth headers path=%s x_user_id=%q x_user_role=%q", r.URL.Path, r.Header.Get("X-User-ID"), r.Header.Get("X-User-Role"))
			http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
			return
		}
		ctx := contextWithUser(r.Context(), userID, role)
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
	})
}

// RequireRole ensures user role among allowed.
func RequireRole(roles ...string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	allowed := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, r := range roles {
		allowed[strings.ToUpper(r)] = struct{}{}
	}
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			userID, role, ok := UserFromContext(r.Context())
			if !ok || userID == "" || role == "" {
				http.Error(w, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
				return
			}
			if len(allowed) > 0 {
				if _, ok := allowed[strings.ToUpper(role)]; !ok {
					http.Error(w, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
					return
				}
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	}
}

// RequireInternalToken ensures requests use shared secret.
func RequireInternalToken(token string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if token == "" {
				http.Error(w, "internal access disabled", http.StatusForbidden)
				return
			}
			provided := r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token")
			expectedDigest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(token))
			providedDigest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(provided))
			sameLength := subtle.ConstantTimeEq(int32(len(provided)), int32(len(token)))
			if sameLength&subtle.ConstantTimeCompare(expectedDigest[:], providedDigest[:]) != 1 {
				http.Error(w, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
				return
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	}
}

func contextWithUser(ctx context.Context, id, role string) context.Context {
	ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, userIDKey, id)
	ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, userRoleKey, strings.ToUpper(role))
	return ctx
}
